description: This file defines the Processor class within the Todaymade\Daux namespace. The class manages operations related to Daux documentation processing, including manipulating the content tree, extending the Markdown environment, and adding generators and content types.

classes.name: Processor
classes.description: Class for processing Daux documentation tasks such as tree manipulation, environment extension, and content extension.

methods.description: Constructor for Processor class, initializes dependencies: Daux object, output interface, and width parameter.

methods.description: Method to extend or modify the Markdown parser and renderer environment.
